title: thermite-lower: lower_spec_arg drops the byte-view for a FIELD-ACCESS bytes_eq String operand (&result.text / &b.text -> &TString, E0308) — blocks #276 Arc-2
description:
thermite-lower::lower_spec_arg lowers a `bytes_eq` String OPERAND that is a FIELD ACCESS (`&result.text`, `&b.text`) to a `&TString` reference instead of the `Seq<u8>` byte view (`result.text.data@`), causing E0308 at real verus. This blocks #276 Arc-2 (the editor's bytes_eq content pins, whose operands MUST name `result.text` / `b.text` — the Buffer's text field).

ROOT CAUSE (thermite-lower/src/lower.rs, `lower_spec_arg`, ~lines 7595-7646):
- The single-segment-path byteview rule (`if string_as_byteview && segs.len() == 1 && ctx.is_string(name)` -> `{name}.data@`) and the `&<single-segment-path>` ref-strip rule (`Expr::Ref { expr: Expr::Path(segs) } with segs.len()==1`) handle bare String idents (`&ins`, `&result`, `&a`) correctly.
- A String operand that is `Expr::Field` (`result.text`, `b.text`) or `Expr::Ref { expr: Expr::Field {..} }` (`&result.text`, `&b.text`) is NOT matched, so it falls to `lower_expr` and emits `&result.text` (a `&TString`) — wrong type for `bytes_eq(a: Seq<u8>, b: Seq<u8>, ..)`.

MINIMAL REPRO (verus-confirmed E0308 'expected Seq<u8>, found &TString'):
  struct Buf { text: String, cursor: u64 } inv cursor <= text.len() && text.len() <= 1_000_000
  fn ins(b: Buf, s: String) -> Buf
    req b.text.len() + s.len() <= 1_000_000
    ens result.text.len() == b.text.len() + s.len()
    ens bytes_eq(&result.text, &b.text, 0, 0, b.cursor)
    fx alloc
  { let head: String = b.text.slice(0, b.cursor); let tail: String = b.text.slice(b.cursor, b.text.len());
    Buf { text: head.concat(s).concat(tail), cursor: b.cursor + s.len() } }
emits `__thermite_bytes_eq(&result.text, &b.text, 0 as int, ...)` -> E0308.

The C8 demo (conformance/bytes_eq_demo.th) never tripped this — it uses ONLY flat String params / the whole result (all single-segment paths). The gap is field-access String operands.

FIX (in thermite-lower/src/lower.rs::lower_spec_arg only): when `string_as_byteview` and the operand is an `Expr::Field` (or `Expr::Ref` wrapping an `Expr::Field`) whose field type is `String`, emit `<base>.<field>.data@` (the `Seq<u8>` view), mirroring the existing single-segment `{name}.data@` rule. The field's String-ness check must use the in-scope struct/field type info (the same machinery the struct-invariant weave uses for `b.text`).

ACCEPTANCE: the minimal repro above certifies L3 through real verus; #276's editor.th `insert_str`/`backspace`/`render_frame` content pins certify L3; conformance/bytes_eq_demo.th + sum.th + bytes_eq_demo.cert.json byte-stable (no regression — only field-access operands change). Then #276 Arc-2 re-dispatches.

Surfaced by #276 Arc-2 (3rd STOP). #277 + #278 already landed and work; this is a distinct, narrow lowering gap.
